players.bio: Adrián de la Fuente Barquilla (born 26 February 1999), sometimes known as Dela, is a Spanish footballer who plays as a central defender for Levante UD.

Aïssa Mandi (Arabic: عيسى ماندي; born 22 October 1991) is a professional footballer who plays for Ligue 1 club Lille. Born in France, he plays for the Algeria national team. Mainly a centre-back, he can also play as a right-back. Mandi made his international debut for Algeria in March 2014.

Alejandro Primo Hernández (born 10 July 2004) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Atlético Levante UD. Primo was born in Valencia, and was a Levante UD youth graduate. He was a part of the reserves in the 2021–22 Segunda División RFEF, but acted only as a third-choice.
Axel Tape-Kobrissa (born 10 August 2007) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or midfielder for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen.
Carlos Álvarez Rivera (born 6 August 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Levante UD.
Karl Edouard Blaise Etta Eyong (born 14 October 2003) is a Cameroonian footballer who plays as either a midfielder or a forward for La Liga club Levante and the Cameroon national team.
Hugo Sotelo Gómez (born 19 December 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Celta.

Ifeanyi Ndukwe is an 18-year-old Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Liverpool F.C.. Known for his towering 6-foot-6-inch (1.98m) frame and athletic aerial dominance, he is widely considered one of Europe's top young defensive prospects.
Iván Romero de Ávila Araque (born 10 April 2001), known as Iván Romero, is a Spanish footballer who plays as a forward for Levante UD.
Jeremy Isaiah Richard Toljan (born 8 August 1994) is a German professional footballer who plays as a right back for Levante.
Jon Ander Olasagasti Imizcoz (born 16 August 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Levante UD.
Jorge Cabello Trujillo (born 25 April 2004) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a centre-back for Levante UD.

Kareem Tunde Ruiz is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right winger for EFL Championship club West Bromwich Albion. Career Born in Barcelona, Catalonia to a Nigerian mother and a Spanish father, Tunde joined FC Barcelona's La Masia in June 2017, from RCD Espanyol. He left the club in 2020, and spent two years at CF Damm before moving to the youth categories of Levante UD.
Kervin Fabián Arriaga Villanueva (born 5 January 1998) is a Honduran professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Levante
Luís Manuel Ferreira de Castro (born 7 May 1980) is a Portuguese football manager, who is the head coach of La Liga club Levante.
Manuel "Manu" Sánchez de la Peña (born 24 August 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Levante UD, on loan from RC Celta de Vigo.
Oriol Rey Erenas (born 25 February 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or centre-back for Levante UD.
Pablo Cuñat Campos (born 28 April 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Levante UD.

Petar Ratkov (born 18 August 2003) is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for Serie A club Lazio and the Serbia national team Career On 18 June 2023, Ratkov signed for reigning Austrian Bundesliga champions Red Bull Salzburg on a five-year contract. International career Ratkov is of mixed Bulgarian and Croatian descent.
Roger Brugué Ayguade (born 4 November 1996), commonly known as Brugui, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Levante UD. Mainly a winger, he can also play as a wing-back.
Víctor García Raja (born 16 September 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as either a right back or a right winger for Levante UD.
